sm.$description: Height of small interactive controls: compact buttons, inputs, and selects (8x the brand space base).

md.$description: Default height of interactive controls: buttons, inputs, and selects (10x the brand space base).

lg.$description: Height of large interactive controls for prominent actions (12x the brand space base).

sm.$description: Maximum inline size of narrow content columns: settings pages, forms, prose (16x the md control height / derived.space.8; 640px at the default brand). Matches the lg dialog width derivation. Use this — never a space token or a raw calc — for content column widths (NR-006).

md.$description: Maximum inline size of standard content columns: list pages, dashboards with a single column (24x the md control height / derived.space.8; 960px at the default brand). Use this — never a space token or a raw calc — for content column widths (NR-006).

lg.$description: Maximum inline size of wide page shells: multi-column dashboards, full-width app frames (30x the md control height / derived.space.8; 1200px at the default brand). Use this — never a space token or a raw calc — for content column widths (NR-006).

sm.$description: Icon and spinner size inside compact controls and dense UI (4x the brand space base). Use this — never a space token — to size an element.

md.$description: Default icon and spinner size alongside body text and inside md controls (5x the brand space base). Use this — never a space token — to size an element.

lg.$description: Icon and spinner size for prominent controls, empty states, and alerts (6x the brand space base). Use this — never a space token — to size an element.
